rules.numbers: every number, date or amount in a post must be one of the item's allowed_numbers, as written there
rules.picks: never name or hint at the #1 pick; it is locked and not in this file
rules.no_advice: no buy / sell calls, predictions or price targets; every post carries the disclaimer
rules.descriptive: chart_pattern and moves_like describe what happened only (no forecasts; their items' banned_words apply too); moves_like may cashtag only the peers listed in its item
rules.cashtags: one cashtag per post (the item's ticker); several only for earnings_tomorrow_roundup and ptr_summary (at most 4, all from the item's tickers), moves_like (its peers) and picks_ready (the public picks)
rules.order: items are sorted by rank (newsworthiness, highest first; rank_why says why): post in that order

reasons.picks_ready: the published list (2026-10-12) expires 2026-10-13T17:30:00+00:00 before the 15:00 ET slot; today's list publishes at 1:30 PM ET
